`class FlexNode`<br/>
**Extends:** [`Node`](/reference/nodes/node/)<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`ReorderableFlexNode`](/reference/layout/reorderableflexnode/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.node.impl.layout` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [FlexNode.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/node/impl/layout/FlexNode.java)

Places its visible children one after the other in a column or a row, and takes the size of its content.

![Four blue rectangles in a row, evenly spaced](/captures/catalog-nodes-flexnode.webp)

## Description

On the main axis, a size of `0` takes the size of the content; a declared size is a minimum without overflow, and a fixed size with an overflow.
The children keep their own position as an offset that moves the child alone, without pushing the next ones; an `ABSOLUTE` or hidden child is left out.
